canonical_positioning.rule: Current public and governance terminology must use Language Module Framework for LOC and Symbolic Language Module for LunaRunes. Language System Model, LOC6 Methodology, and LOC7 Algorithm are superseded current-positioning terms and may remain only in explicit historical records.

principles.ui_rule: LOC1–8 are retained only as homepage guide labels for human explanation. They are not backend taxonomy, ownership IDs, API fields, KM categories, FAQ ownership, or engineering variable names.
principles.misc_rule: New or unresolved cross-domain material may enter LOC8 temporarily and should move to a clearer primary owner when responsibility becomes stable.
principles.stable_framework_mutable_language: Stable identities, schemas, responsibility domains and provenance rules govern a language layer whose meanings, relations and interpretations may evolve.
principles.historical_integrity: Original records are retained; later interpretations may supersede but must not silently rewrite historical evidence.
principles.plurality: Competing interpretations may coexist when provenance, context and lifecycle status remain explicit.
principles.boundary_model: Govern by domain/scope/ownership/permission boundaries rather than a single universal moral bottom-line vocabulary.
principles.domain_rule: Use semantic domains in implementation: runes, context, music, literary, media, governance, knowledge, evolution, global.
principles.legacy_loc_rule: Existing LOC1–8 fields may remain temporarily for compatibility during migration, but no new backend dependency may be introduced.

terminology.rule: Current-facing public copy, FAQ/RAG, KM, Skills and runtime projections must prefer this registry over superseded terminology in legacy source snapshots.

analysis_boundary.LOC6: Algorithm: repeatable semantic analysis, judgment, governance, Zhengde Style interpretation, classification and decision rules derived from source evidence.
analysis_boundary.LOC7: Module: reusable computation and knowledge modules that organize text architecture, KM, retrieval, RAG, Graph RAG traversal, validation and semantic engineering.
analysis_boundary.LOC8: Evolution: time, period, Event timeline, Trajectory and Trend projections. It may display Graph views but does not own graph relation semantics.
analysis_boundary.LOC4: Creative/life-writing text authority plus work-level and chapter-level literary/semantic analysis.
analysis_boundary.LOC2: Context, relationship, Scenario/Event relation and Canonical Graph semantics.

rights_boundary.LOC6: Defines or executes governance-related algorithms and principles for authorship, attribution, sharing, licensing, and collaboration.
rights_boundary.LOC8: Maintains shared rights/provenance references and identity linkage.
rights_boundary.LOC3_LOC4_LOC5: Attach concrete work/media rights and provenance values by reference.

governance_control_plane.rule: A governance policy is not complete until Principle -> Policy -> Executable Control -> Evidence/Audit Trail can be demonstrated.

cross_domain_rule: A domain may reference, consume, analyze or propose changes to another domain's authoritative record, but must not overwrite that domain's canonical ownership.

loc4_loc6_boundary.rule: Raw authored text and ordinary work/chapter analysis remain LOC4. Governance/value/Zhengde-style interpretations derived from those texts are LOC6 algorithm outputs.
loc4_loc6_boundary.platform_rule: Facebook/Threads are LOC4 life-writing sources; platform does not make them LOC6.
loc4_loc6_boundary.no_overwrite: LOC6 references LOC4 evidence and creates separate derived records; it never changes LOC4 canonical text.

backend_domain_map.runes: LunaRunes / rune semantics and draw records
backend_domain_map.knowledge: Knowledge / KM / retrieval / reusable modules / RAG
